_scope: The GET /config form's noise_filter select (13 options), in curated display order rather than form order. Raw name -> family label, variant label (null throughout: no subgroup would hold more than one member), leaf label. Family is the filter's design lineage, leaf is the rest. A fourth field, `short`, is the closed-dropdown title: family and leaf composed with ` · `, with the word 'phase' dropped per the filter overlay's short convention. Leaf labels unique within their family; short titles unique across the list. `rec: true` marks the options the manual flags Recommended; entries without the flag carry no key.

families.Dedicated: Filters designed specifically for DSD noise, matched to how the source was made
families.Averaging: Averaging stages that turn the bitstream into PCM directly, filtering as a side effect
families.Roll-off ladder: General filters ordered by strength: slow keeps bandwidth and noise, brickwall cuts both
